# collections.library: Hash

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> The digest of a typed index. Every IIndex implementor is a single-field
> wrapper over Integer, so the raw value's hash is the whole content of the
> value and is therefore consistent with structural equality by construction.

## Signature

```plato
Hash(self: IIndex): Integer
```
